"I was bitten by a snake."
This article is about a subject that is relevant to both the main Ninjago storyline and The LEGO Ninjago Movie. Information may be more directed toward one continuity than the other.

The following is a list of unseen characters from the franchise who are mentioned no more than once.

Acronix and Krux's mother[]

“Mother always said he was stubborn.”
— Acronix, "Pause and Effect"

An unnamed woman is the mother of the Time Twins, Acronix and Krux.

History

History[]

At some point in her life, she gave birth to the twin Elemental Masters of Time, Krux and Acronix, three minutes apart from each other, Krux first, Acronix second.[1] According to Acronix, she always said Krux was stubborn.[2]

Appearances

Appearances[]

Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu[]

Season 7: The Hands of Time[]

  • 72. "Pause and Effect" (mentioned)
Trivia

Trivia[]

  • She did not have the element of Time,[3] though its unknown if her partner had the element or if neither of them were.

Ancients of the Wyldness[]

“According to the ancients of my land, these doors were sealed long ago, intended to never be opened, except by a power of a Source Dragon.”
— Ras to Jordana, "The Blood Moon"

The Ancients of the Wyldness were a group of anthropomorphic tigers[5] that were knowledged on their realm's history.

History

History[]

At some point in time, they told Ras about the origins of the Shadow Dojo and that it could supposedly only be opened with the use of a Source Dragon's energy.

Firstbourne (ancestor)
Matriarch of Fallen Leaves (mother; deceased)[7]
An unnamed Forest Dragon is an Arc Dragon and the child of the deceased Matriarch of Fallen Leaves and the next leader of a tribe of Forest Dragons in the Fallen Leaves.

History

History[]

Background[]

At some point before her death, the Matriarch had given birth to a child.

The Shape of Motion[]

When the Source Dragon of Motion appeared to the ninja, she informed them that the Matriarch of the Mountain Dragons wasn't the only Dragon that had been slain, as she showed all the Arc Dragons that were killed for their crowns. The symbol of the Matriarch was present, meaning she had been also slain. Also meaning her child is now the new Arc Dragon of the Fallen Leaves.

History

History[]

The Carnus Conclave were renowned wizards, known for prognosticating future events and selling their precognitions to the highest bidders. At some point, they tried to free Thunderfang, which did not end well.[17] Later, at one point, they unwisely crossed their powerful clients, which ultimately led to their collapse.[18] During this incident, Gandalaria's life was saved by her own crystal ball, causing her to become more sentimental towards it.

Agent Debra is an Administration Agent.

History

History[]

Casket of Bones[]

When the headquarters of the Administration became victim to an invasion from Spectral Dragonians under the leadership of Drix, Debra was one of the numerous members that had their souls stolen and taken to the Well of the Lost while those who were drained became hollowed, wandering through the office blocks in a mindless state. The fate of Debra and their colleagues left a Munce agent that had been able to survive the initial attack fearful that he would meet the same fate, despite attempted reassurances from SsssSsss Underwood and Roderick Allen. In response, the Munce pointed out the state that their invisible attackers had reduced Debra, Carl B and the entire HR department to.

Chaos Reigns[]

After the defeat of Thunderfang at the hands of the reawakened Arc Dragon of Focus, the souls that the Forbidden Five had stolen to fuel his attempt to become a Source Dragon were returned to their original owners, including the members of the Administration.

History

History[]

Mrs. Grumbmiller was said to be mean and to have a large mole on an unspecified part of her body. When she made Kai and Nya go to bed early, they tripped her.[38]

Kex'k Metalwing, was a dragon warrior during the War of Oni and Dragon[49] from the Dragons of the Northern Spiral.[46] He was known to be a fearsome Oni-Slayer, the builder of Forgotten Tombs as well as the Sobrient Stone's keeper before Thunderfang took it.[50][51]

History

History[]

Part of the Dragons of the Northern Spiral, Kex'k fought in the War of Oni and Dragon, where he was a great warrior in the Dragon army. He was also the keeper of the Sobrient Stone. At some point before the Battle of the City of Temples, Metalwing passed away, allowing for Thunderfang to take the stone for himself.[52]

Trivia

Trivia[]

  • His existence was revealed by Chris "Doc" Wyatt via BlueSky.[50]
  • Kex‘k Metalwing was one of the most powerful dragons in the dragon army during the war.[49]
  • Metalwing was the closest dragon in power level to the Omega.[9]
    • The two were rivals, but not in terms of power level, but with the rise of Therox.[53]
  • He, Ekesian Coldfang the Wise and Urd Leatherwing are the only full-blooded dragons to have surnames.
  • He was not born with an Elemental Power.[53]
  • Kex‘k knew the First Spinjitzu Master.[53]
  • He had one metal wing to replace the one he lost due to a war injury.[54]
  • He was not murdered.[53]
  • He knew Egalt.[55]

The Minkans were an ancient civilization in Ninjago that were known for having created the Amulet of Protection.

History

History[]

Long before the series[]

The Minkan civilization was founded in Ninjago and vanished. Amongst their surviving artifacts included the Amulet of Protection, which was said to be able to protect its bearer from danger. One such amulet would come into the possession of the legendary explorer Clutch Powers years later, who carried the amulet on his many adventures.

Boobytraps and How to Survive Them[]

As Clutch Powers escaped the pyramid, he was confronted by Aspheera, who told the archeologist to take her to Ninjago City. Powers refused and held up the Amulet of Protection to defend himself, mentioning it came from the Minkans.

The Mythica were a tribe of nomadic storyteller dragons who travelled through the realms, sharing story-songs, until they were hunted to extinction by the Oni, who wished to silence their stories.[60]

History

History[]

When the name of time was still new, the Mythica travelled across the realms and shared story-songs. At some point, the tribe helped the City of Temples transport itself from realm to realm through an ancient blessing and many of their Spirit Dragons swore their servitude to the city.[61] One of the stories they told was of Wojira to the residents of the Never-Realm.

Eventually, the remaining members of the tribe were hunted to extinction by the Oni, who wished to silence their stories.

Trivia

Trivia[]

  • According to Chris "Doc" Wyatt, they are the reason why the inhabitants of the Never-Realm knew about Wojira.[60]
  • The Mythica are likely a reference to the LEGOLAND attraction of the same name.

Oni warlords[]

“Each mask embodies one of the three Oni warlords. If all three masks are united, whomever owns them will wield tremendous power.”
— Hutchins to the ninja, "The Mask of Deception"

First appearance

The Oni warlords were three Oni leaders during the War of Oni and Dragon. The Oni Masks were made to resemble them.

History

History[]

The Oni warlords were the original leaders of the Oni during their war with the dragons. When the First Spinjitzu Master escaped from the Realm of Oni and Dragons to create Ninjago, the warlords pursued him. In doing so, they crafted three Oni Masks, each symbolizing one of the Oni warlords. During their invasion of Ninjago, one of the three warlords, known as Mystake, eventually turned on the other two when she discovered the beauty of the world created by the First Spinjitzu Master. She allied herself with the Spinjitzu Master and destroyed her two former counterparts.[64]

Other appearances and mentions[]

Iron & Stone[]

Scar eagerly awaited the start of the fight between Kai, Jay, Zane, and Slab. However, his anticipation was interrupted when he accidentally bumped into Cole and Wu, who were in disguise. In their brief interaction, Cole introduced himself as "Rocky Dangerbuff." Believing that Cole and Wu were part of the Dangerbuff clan, Scar mentioned that he knew Stalwart and thought he should meet them. Unfortunately, Cole and Wu managed to escape before Scar could locate Stalwart.

Etymology

Etymology[]

Yuuki is an alternate transcription of Yūki.

  • The name Yuuki is written in katakana (ユウキ), which has no special meaning. However, when written in kanji (優希, 悠希, 優輝 or 悠生), it could possibly mean:
    • 優希 - "excellence, superiority, gentleness" (優) (yū) and "hope" (希) (ki).
    • 悠希 - "permanence" (悠) (yū) and "hope" (希) (ki).
    • 優輝 - "excellence, superiority, gentleness" (優) (yū) and "brightness, radiance, shine, sparkle, gleam, twinkle" (輝) (ki).
    • 悠生 - "permanence" (悠) (yū) and "life, living" (生) (ki).
Trivia
